title: Choose the Dancer page's world
question: The roll assigned the Tanzfahrplan: the dance week set like a pocket bus timetable. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Tanzfahrplan
options.lineage: German pocket timetables and bus-stop signs (yellow H, green ink)
options.thesis: Tonight's dancing read like a departure timetable: times in one column, styles as coloured lines, each Flyer hanging under its time.
options.viewport: Yellow header with green wordmark, type tabs, style line badges as filters, a green 'Heute · Mi 4.11.' band, then 18:15 in the time column above the whole Flyer.
options.risk: Can read municipal or dry if the Flyers are not allowed to dominate.

raised.raise: Flyers sit as untouched plates: nothing is laid over the artwork, captions live beside it.
Saved Events are first-class: a ticked mark on each row, kept on the device.
Each style owns one full-strength line colour, identical in filters, badges and rows.
Times hang in one fixed tabular column; the page reflows by whole rows, never ragged.
Filters sit directly above what they scope and apply on one tap.

options.label: Termine
options.thesis: The week as a city magazine's listings page: huge day numerals, category kickers, Flyers in the column.
options.viewport: 'Termine' masthead, a type and filter strip, a giant '4 Mittwoch' numeral beside the day's entries and their Flyers.
options.risk: Familiar: the editorial-listings look many runs land on.

options.label: Ticket wallet
options.thesis: Each Event a coupon in the week's wallet; cancelled ones get a red VOID stamp.
options.viewport: Navy wallet, coupon heads with time, place and km in boxed fields, the Flyer as the coupon's body.
options.case: Holds audience identification (Dancers know tickets); loses on clarity, since coupons box the Flyer in chrome.
options.risk: Coupon chrome competes with the Flyers and echoes an earlier ticket prototype.

options.label: Design annual plates
options.thesis: Flyers as reproduced plates with registration marks.
options.viewport: One plate per screen with a credits row.
options.case: Dancers don't read design annuals; the gallery framing slows 'what's on tonight'.
options.kept: Flyers stay untouched plates, no UI over the artwork.

options.label: Convention catalog
options.thesis: Every Flyer a stamp-sized cell, circled in biro.
options.viewport: Dense thumbnail grid with table codes.
options.case: Stamp-sized Flyers break the whole-Flyer rule; no local identification.
options.kept: Marked state as a first-class, device-kept mark.

options.label: Manual tab board
options.thesis: Days as hued tab dividers down the fore edge.
options.viewport: A stepped tab rail with the current day's board.
options.case: Manuals mean nothing to Dancers; tab rail duplicates the day nav.
options.risk: Costume of an object nobody here owns.
options.kept: One full-strength hue per division, used everywhere.

options.label: Grid specimen
options.thesis: Dates built from a visible construction grid.
options.viewport: A monumental grid-built date over the list.
options.case: Rewards designers, not Dancers; numerals fight the Flyers.
options.kept: A visible, strict column grid that reflows by whole cells.

options.label: Type specimen
options.thesis: One slider remaps the whole page.
options.viewport: A giant glyph and a live axis readout.
options.case: No real axis in a dance week to drive; no identification.
options.kept: One control re-scopes everything beneath it at once.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: An event app's clean feed: search pill, tab chips, Flyer cards with a caption, blue accent.
canonCard.viewport: Location pill, type chips, 'Heute, Mittwoch 4. November', then a Flyer card with title, time, Venue and km.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every event listing by design.
